headline: Arbon Earth secures first marine CDR permit in Indonesia
summary: Sweden's Arbon Earth won a first-of-its-kind Indonesian permit to run deep-sea marine carbon removal, sinking cultivated seaweed off Lombok, working with the Ministry of Marine Affairs and Fisheries (KKP).
organisations: Indonesia Ministry of Marine Affairs and Fisheries
co2crc_note: Marine CDR outside CO2CRC's geological-storage focus, but signals Indonesia's widening CO2-removal regulatory activity in the APAC neighbourhood.

headline: NYK buys 30% stake in Vår Energi's Trudvang offshore CO2 storage project
summary: Japanese shipping major NYK is taking a 30% interest in Vår Energi's Trudvang CCS partnership and the EXL 007 storage licence in the Norwegian North Sea (initial 2 Mtpa, >10 Mtpa potential), its first direct equity in geological CO2 storage; post-deal ownership is Vår Energi 40% / INPEX Idemitsu Norge 30% / NYK 30%.
co2crc_note: A CO2-shipping major buying into European storage is the cross-border capture-here/store-there model CO2CRC tracks for Australia-APAC (e.g. Bayu-Undan, Japan-Malaysia).
extractor_note: No transaction value disclosed; 2 Mtpa is the project's initial storage injection capacity, not a new commitment.

headline: Louisiana Public Broadcasting documentary examines the state's carbon capture debate
summary: 'Going Underground: Carbon Capture in Louisiana' premiered on Louisiana Public Broadcasting, weighing safety, federal incentives, property rights and the role of CCS in cutting emissions.
co2crc_note: US social-licence bellwether; Louisiana's property-rights and pipeline-safety debate mirrors the community-consent challenges facing any onshore CCS.

headline: Pertamina Hulu Energi pushes Asri Basin as a regional CO2 storage hub
summary: PHE, with ExxonMobil, is positioning the offshore Asri Basin (est. 2.9 Gt potential) as an integrated regional CCS hub with LCO2 shipping, a reception terminal, offshore pipeline and injection wells; Indonesia's national storage potential is put at ~578 Gt across 20 basins.
co2crc_note: Indonesia's Asri hub is a direct APAC analogue/competitor to Australian cross-border storage ambitions; import-CO2 hub strategy worth monitoring.
extractor_note: 2.9 Gt / 578 Gt are cumulative storage-resource estimates, not Mtpa commitments (Indonesian-language source).

headline: Cotierra raises $3M to scale decentralised biochar
summary: Zurich-based Cotierra closed a $3M round (co-led by Paulig's PINC and Carbon Removal Partners) to commercialise decentralised, farm-level biochar production for durable carbon removal, starting with coffee residues.
co2crc_note: Biochar CDR seed round; peripheral to engineered CCS but part of the broader durable-removal financing picture.
extractor_note: Biochar CDR has no exact value_chain vocab token; used not-applicable.
